name: Turborepo Boilerplate
summary: Turborepo boilerplate pairing a Next.js web app with a WXT browser extension, sharing shadcn/ui components.
description: Monorepo starter for projects that need both a web app and a browser extension: a Next.js app and a WXT extension app sharing shadcn/ui UI components, with unified TypeScript, ESLint, Tailwind CSS and Prettier configs. The README covers prerequisites, install and dev servers (extension on localhost:3000, web app on localhost:3001).
contains: Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js web app and a WXT browser extension
unified TypeScript, ESLint, Tailwind CSS and Prettier configs
extension dev server on localhost:3000, web app on localhost:3001
